05 / 13.06.2023 Heard the parties.
2. Petitioners are apprehending their arrest in connection with Kairo P.S. Case No. 37/2022 for the offences registered under sections 341/323/377/498A/313 of the Indian Penal Code and section 3 /
4 of Dowry prohibition Act, pending in the court of learned Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate,
Lohardaga.
3.
Mr. Altamash Khan, learned counsel appearing for the petitioners, submitted that the parties have settled their dispute.
4. Mr. Uttam Kumar Das, learned counsel, has appeared on behalf of opposite party no. 2.
He also conceded that the parties have settled their dispute.
5. This case relates to the matrimonial dispute between the parties and it appears that the parties have already settled their dispute.

sentences.text: Considering the aforesaid facts, I am inclined to extend the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioners.

Accordingly, petitioners, above named, are directed to surrender before the learned court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order and the learned court below on their surrender, shall release them on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 25,000/-
(Rupees twenty five thousand) each, with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Lohardaga in connection with Kairo P.S. Case No.
37/2022, subject to the conditions as laid down under section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

(Ambuj Nath, J) Ranjeet/
